picks.title: MegaSaM: Accurate, Fast and Robust Structure and Motion from Casual Dynamic Videos
picks.takeaway: 面向随意拍摄的动态视频，快速稳健估计相机内参与运动结构。
picks.why: CVPR 2025 Best Paper Honorable Mention，实用场景验证充分。

picks.title: Navigation World Models
picks.takeaway: 以世界模型预测导航未来观测，支撑具身智能体的路径决策。
picks.why: CVPR 2025 Honorable Mention，LeCun等参与，具身方向强信号。

picks.title: ReconVLA: Reconstructive Vision-Language-Action Model as Effective Robot Perceiver
picks.takeaway: 用重建式视觉语言动作模型提升机器人对目标区域的感知精度。
picks.why: AAAI-26官方Outstanding Paper Award，VLA方向获奖级工作。

picks.title: LLM2CLIP: Powerful Language Model Unlocks Richer Cross-Modality Representation
picks.takeaway: 把大语言模型接入CLIP文本侧，解锁更强的跨模态表征能力。
picks.why: AAAI-26官方Outstanding Paper Award，多模态表征代表作。
